text: Tarfin began operating in 2017 as a technology platform offering forward-purchase (vadeli) trading in agriculture, and its Tarfin Flex unit is a wholly owned subsidiary of Tarfin Tarım A.Ş. Its December 2021 funding round included Yara Growth Ventures, Quona Capital, Elevator Ventures (Raiffeisen Bank), Syngenta Group Ventures, Collective Spark Fund and Wamda. Ali Emre Ballı chairs its board, with Yiğit Gözübüyük as vice chairman.
short: Tarfin is a Turkish agritech platform backed by venture investors.
